scope: Make LEADER DXF per-coordinate vertex creation exception-safe and preserve field ordinals across allocation failure.

implementation.behavior: LEADER now prepares all missing shared coordinate objects in a temporary vector through a noexcept allocator helper, reserves the destination, and only then publishes the points and advances the per-field occurrence counter. Allocation failures leave vertexlist and the ordinal unchanged, allowing the same coordinate group to be retried.
implementation.failureInjection: The focused test injects one std::bad_alloc at each of the missing-point temporary reserve, shared-coordinate allocation, and destination reserve. Every failure is observed once; the vertex list remains empty; retrying group 10 followed by group 20 produces the expected single point.

validation.fixturePolicy: The fault-injection tests use locally generated in-memory DXF group records. No DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limitations: This covers LEADER DXF coordinate-point allocation only; other LEADER field/string allocations and DWG parsing remain in the broader safety audit.
The focused controls establish parser failure/retry and coordinate transport, not physical producer breadth, whole-document conversion, or native annotation semantics.
next: Continue P6 safety review at another reproduced parser allocation or rollback boundary.
